description: Java class for monitoring network status changes in an Android environment, including callbacks for network availability and loss, and methods to manage network callback registration and check connectivity.

classes.name: NetworkStatus
classes.description: Class to monitor network connectivity status and notify changes via native callback.

classes.name: CobaltNetworkCallback
classes.description: Inner class extending ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback to handle network availability and loss events.

methods.name: sendStatusChange
methods.description: Posts a runnable to the main handler to log and process network status change.

methods.name: sendStatusChangeInternal
methods.description: Calls native method to notify about network status change.

methods.name: NetworkStatus
methods.description: Constructor initializing network callback and registering it with ConnectivityManager.

methods.name: beforeStartOrResume
methods.description: Re-registers network callback if not already registered.

methods.name: beforeSuspend
methods.description: Unregisters network callback to suspend monitoring.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks current network capabilities to determine if device is connected via various transports.

methods.name: nativeOnNetworkStatusChange
methods.description: Native method called to notify status change.
